title: VooPoo Vinci Spark 100 Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Vinci Spark 100 Vape Kit blends dazzling aesthetics with Voopoo’s cutting-edge vape technology to create a truly premium sub-ohm vaping experience. Crafted from durable aluminium alloy with classic, clean, minimalist lines, this device features a magnetic side panel and an enchanting starlight LED display that boasts three unique animation modes—Shooting Stars, Starry Sky, and Rhythmic Arrows. Compact and sleek, the Vinci Spark 100 is as eye-catching as it is practical. Powered by a single 18650 battery (sold separately) , the Vinci Spark 100 delivers up to 100W of variable output, catering to both direct-to-lung (DTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vaping styles. Equipped with Voopoo’s advanced GENE.AI 2.0 chipset, the device offers intelligent features such as Smart Mode, ECO Mode for battery efficiency, and RBA Mode for customisable settings. The responsive side firing button allows effortless navigation through the 0.96” TFT screen, which displays all key vaping metrics at a glance. The kit includes the Uforce-X Nano Tank, a 2ml sub-ohm tank engineered for superior vapour production and exceptional flavour delivery. Featuring a convenient top-fill mechanism and adjustable airflow, this tank provides effortless refills and a tailored vaping experience. Compatible with Voopoo’s high-performance PnP X coils, the Uforce-X Nano ensures consistent flavour, dense vapour, and reliable leak-resistance, making it ideal for high-VG e-liquids. With its impressive visuals and design, innovative features, and outstanding performance, the Voopoo Vinci Spark 100 Vape Kit is an excellent choice for vapers seeking a premium sub-ohm setup. Note: Please use the 0.6ohm RDL Coil with the Bar Salts E-Liquid and use Double Drip E-Liquid with the 0.3ohm is a DTL Coil and suited for High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-Liquid only. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
